title: AI News Daily — September 2, 2026
summary: Anthropic shipped Claude Fable 5.1 and a tightly restricted Mythos 5.1, cutting typical costs 25% while lifting coding and research scores. And Cognition is closing in on a $1 billion raise at a $47 billion valuation, nearly double its price from three months ago.
